_about: Copied 2026-10-19 from the function catalogue's ALL.values.json (rea-targets/dcre-research/functions): every value, error and no-evaluation row that calls cov, covp, corr, spearman, sort, unique, join, repeat, argmin, argmax, frequency (which Desmos does not define), the hidden sortPerm, complexSortPerm, uniquePerm and shuffle, or the hidden names Desmos's calculator refuses (repeatAssert, frequencyList, frequencyListAssert, sortedLastLessIndex, sortedLastLessEqualIndex), except the three already in desmos-statistics.fixture.json, plus values_degree_mode as "[deg] " keys. Keys without their own rows (" ;; ", " ; " or " ⟹ " separated) are evaluated after _rows. null = undefined; a point is [x, y]. The two shuffle values, which the catalogue describes as a seeded permutation rather than a number list, are left out.
